records.text: TABAN: Hey, {Donkey}!
TABAN: You're {Donkey}'s friend right?
TABAN: I'd like to see more of her.{br}I've been making items she'd like.
TABAN: Oh you're just in time.
TABAN: It's my finest work!{br}The ultimate in defense for my,{br}daughter!
TABAN: Take a look {Donkey}!{br}I borrowed a bit of the Sun Stone to{br}create something nifty!
BAKER: What do we do?
BAKER: It worked!{br}Precisely as we intended!{br}Please ignore my surprise.
BAKER: A volunteer!{br}Shrek, the platform is reinforced.
BAKER: We tested it on an onion.{br}It arrived in one piece.{br}Mostly the same piece.{page}Please step up!
BAKER: Step up! Donkey presents{br}a machine that will make{br}walking almost unnecessary!
BAKER: Start on this platform...
BAKER: ...and arrive over there!{br}Donkey built it. I supplied{br}the heatproof parts.
BAKER: Our next volunteer!{br}Please keep all royal jewelry{br}inside the machine.
BAKER: A round of applause{br}when she returns, please!
BAKER: Power is ready!
BAKER: Donkey! Where is she?
BAKER: The show is over!{br}Please leave in an orderly panic.
BAKER: That was not a landing!{br}Where did you send her?
BAKER: You are going after her?{br}Then hold on to that pendant.
TABAN: Here's what we earned today!
LARA: You're so thoughtful.
TABAN: Yum!{br}Lemonade sure tastes great{br}outdoors!
TABAN: {Shrek}, have a sip!{br}You're the Hero today.
TABAN: Phew!{br}Made it just in time!{br}Shall I fire one off?{delay 10}{instant}KING: Uh, no Taban.{br}Actually, I could really use your help…{delay 6}{delay 0}
Keita Eto: It'll cost you 10,000,000G to{br}fix a broken map!
